blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — Thousands of residents and tourists flocked to Bacolod over the weekend for the 2026 MassKara Festival street dancing and arena competitions, featuring colorful costumes, elaborate choreography and the festival’s signature smiling masks. Barangay Taculing emerged as grand champion of the barangay street dance and arena competition on Sunday, winning the P1-million top prize and P150,000 in special awards for Best in Theme and Concept, Best in Music and Best in Introduction. Placing first runner-up, Barangay Mandalagan won P500,000 and the Best in Mask and Costume award worth P50,000. Barangay Handumanan finished second runner-up, receiving P300,000 […]...
